10997.title: Farewell My Concubine
10997.overview: In an epic tale of theater, gender, love and class, two Beijing opera actors navigate political turmoil as their friendship evolves over decades.

44725.title: One Piece: Chopper's Kingdom on the Island of Strange Animals
44725.overview: As the Straw Hat Pirates sail through the Grand Line, a sudden eruption of geysers beneath the Going Merry sends the crew flying over a nearby island. In the chaos, Chopper falls overboard and becomes separated from his friends. While Luffy and the others land on the far side of the island, Chopper finds himself hailed as the new king by the local animals. However, danger looms as a group of human “horn hunters” arrives. Their leader, Count Butler, is a violin-playing man who consumes horns to gain strength, and he seeks to devour the island’s greatest treasure to inherit immense power. Can Luffy and the crew stop Count Butler’s scheme and save the island? And will they be able to show Momambi that not all pirates are the villains he believes them to be?
44725.original_title: ワンピース 珍獣島のチョッパー王国

84981.title: Francesco
84981.overview: The life of St. Francis of Assisi (1181-1226) as related by followers who gather after his death to tell stories so that Leone can record them: a privileged and virile youth, a prisoner of war, an heir who turns away from his father and gives all to the poor, a beggar for others, and an inspiration to friends who accept the Gospels' life of poverty.

747509.title: Ah Girl
747509.overview: Singapore, 1994. Ah Girl is a curious 7-year-old girl. Since her parents separated, she lives in a small flat with her younger sister, Ah Tian, her easygoing Pa who works nightshifts, and her irritable Grandmother. They see their needy and unreliable Mum on weekends. One weekend, drunk Mum asks if Ah Girl wants to live with her when she gets a bigger flat. This question disrupts Ah Girl's sense of the world, and the rest of the film unfolds as she struggles with the decision. She becomes increasingly aware that her family life is far from normal.

961077.title: The Little Sister
961077.overview: When Fatima leaves her close-knit suburban family to study philosophy in Paris, she finds herself caught between her religious upbringing and the freedom of student life in the city.

1022453.title: The Rajasaab
1022453.overview: Seeking his lost grandfather, a young man enters a haunted mansion and awakens a family curse powerful enough to upend both his life and reality.
1022453.trailerName: The RajaSaab Glimpse | Prabhas | Maruthi | Thaman S | People Media Factory

1026933.title: Paradise
1026933.overview: The enigmatic captain of a burning cargo ship binds together the fates of two families; one in a bustling Ghanaian city, the other in a quiet Canadian town.

1073973.title: Dead Lover
1073973.overview: A lonely gravedigger who stinks of corpses finally meets her dream man, but their whirlwind affair is cut short when he tragically drowns at sea. Grief-stricken, she goes to morbid lengths to resurrect him through madcap scientific experiments, resulting in grave consequences and unlikely love.

1078581.title: Giant
1078581.overview: Follows Prince Naseem Hamed from his humble beginnings on the tough working-class streets of Sheffield and his discovery by Ingle, himself a steel industry worker turned boxing trainer. Their unlikely partnership, Naz’s unorthodox style, cocky persona, and sheer dominance in the ring propelled them to the top of boxing’s elite and unprecedented levels of global superstardom, all in the face of the rampant Islamophobia and racism of ’80s and 90’s Britain.

1083381.title: Backrooms
1083381.overview: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.

1127861.title: I, Object
1127861.overview: 10-year-old Tom, grieving the loss of his father and unable to relate to the people in his life, takes refuge in the everyday objects around him. Pop can lids, suitcases and untold numbers of everyday objects reveal their true faces and speak to him, helping him on his healing journey.

1134517.title: Streets of Glória
1134517.overview: Gabriel, a 24-year-old anthropologist from a wealthy family from the interior of the Northeast, is gay and in the closet. Following the death of his grandmother, he decides to go to Rio de Janeiro to study the lives of sex workers. Seduced by his object of study, Gabriel will become one of them.

1135285.title: Again Again
1135285.overview: After reliving the same day over and over again for 10 years, Agatha awakens to realize she's escaped and now faces the horrifying reality of a brand new day.

1148213.title: Love, My Way
1148213.overview: Qian was bent on experiencing love and fully committed to every relationship, but all the men she met were unreliable. Qian's best girlfriend, Tingting, also suffered in love, but as time goes by, Qian and Tingting gradually went on to different life trajectories…

1155765.title: Before Dad is Gone
1155765.overview: A family drama film about the final year before his father's passing. The son, Ah Long, who was abandoned by his father as a child due to inherited beliefs, must now care for his father who suffers from Alzheimer's disease.

1166965.title: The Dino Family
1166965.overview: The life of a schoolboy Filipp Dinozavrov is full of failures, but one day he opens a portal to the Mesozoic era.

1172597.title: Lovebirds
1172597.overview: “Love Birds” revolves around a female lovebird who travels the country to find her crush. She travels with an annoying but amusing pigeon, and will discover that all forms of love exists in nature, from gay couples to single moms or stepfamilies, and maybe the one she thinks she is supposed to love may not be “the one.”

1176373.title: Checkout
1176373.overview: Dov, an undercover Mossad agent, gets called for retirement, just as the Mossad's number one target walks into the Turkish hotel where he was stationed. As Israel's intelligence agency interrogates him, Dov will retell and re-adjust the story of taking matters into his own hands, as he is adamant to prove he is still worth something in this world.

1249589.title: Game of Identity
1249589.overview: The story tells the story of Liu Quan Long, a lowly born and independent struggling young man who got the opportunity to exchange his life with a boy from another class in a famous university. Unexpectedly, what was waiting for him was a thrilling game.  Liu Quan Long is an impoverished young man who can't afford to go to university but has a great talent. Before meeting Chen Lun, he was an Internet cafe administrator outside the university who would never be noticed.  Chen Lun has a distinguished family and studied at an elite university just across the street from an internet cafe, but he had no intention of going to school. In order to cope with his parents abroad, he offered Liu Quan Long an invitation to the game of "identity exchange" and asked Liu Quan Long to replace him.

1251701.title: The Saddest Story in the World
1251701.overview: Based on the book by Mário Corso. The story of a boy sold to the circus by his own parents.

1264821.title: Cats in the Museum 2: Treasures of Egypt
1264821.overview: The main characters of the film, the mouse Maurice and the cats Vincent and Cleopatra, will travel from St. Petersburg to Egypt, where they will make new friends, visit the pyramids and open secret dungeons in search of the Genie, who grants one wish once every thousand years. Guests of the presentation were shown a short excerpt in which the characters discover an ancient papyrus with a map and begin to compete with each other.

1265717.title: Familiar Touch
1265717.overview: An octogenarian woman transitions to life in assisted living as she contends with her conflicting relationship to herself and her caregivers amidst her shifting memory, age identity, and desires.

1266805.title: The Musicians
1266805.overview: Astrid Thompson finally succeeds in fulfilling her father's dream: to bring together four Stradivarius for a unique concert, eagerly expected by music lovers around the world. But Lise, George, Peter and Apolline, the four virtuosos recruited for the occasion, are incapable of playing together. The rehearsals are one ego crisis after another. With no solution in sight, Astrid decides to go and find the only person who, in her eyes, can still save the event: Charlie Beaumont, the composer of the score.
1266805.trailerName: The Musicians / Les Musiciens (2025) - Trailer (English Subs)

1291829.title: & Sons
1291829.overview: A world-renowned but reclusive novelist, believing he is about to die, summons his estranged sons to his home. But instead of seeking forgiveness for their shattered family, he tells them a wild and unbelievable secret that could rewrite their past.

1299061.title: Home Stories
1299061.overview: As a contestant in a singing casting show, Lea is asked by the TV team who she is and what makes her special. She doesn't know and begins to slip into different roles in her search for what makes her special, developing an unexpected fascination for her aunt Kati. Kati's return home as head architect for the renovation of the Residenzschloss after many years abroad reunites the family in one place. This reunion raises the hopes of grandparents Friedrich and Christel that they can join forces to give their pension, which has few visitors, a new lease of life.

1305781.title: Blades of the Guardians
1305781.overview: Dao Ma, the "second most wanted fugitive," is entrusted by his benefactor, the chief of Mo family clan, to take on a mysterious escort mission-escorting the "most wanted fugitive" to Chang'an.

1328501.title: The Peril at Pincer Point
1328501.overview: On a quest to prove his competency, an inept sound recordist finds himself entangled in a nautical prophecy on the spectral island of Pincer Point.
1328501.trailerName: The Peril at Pincer Point | Official Trailer

1329909.title: Remake
1329909.overview: The death of his son causes McElwee, an autobiographical filmmaker, to look back on his life’s work. He eventually turns to his archive of home movies. To what extent did his camera affect their relationship when Adrian was alive? To what extent does it define that relationship now that he is gone? Meanwhile, an effort to adapt McElwee’s first feature, Sherman’s March, into a work of fiction lurches along, giving the filmmaker another perspective from which to meditate on movie making and mortality.

1330421.title: Bone Lake
1330421.overview: A couple’s romantic vacation at a secluded lakeside estate is upended when they are forced to share the mansion with a mysterious and attractive couple. In this darkly hilarious and seductive horror story, a dream getaway spirals into a nightmarish maze of sex, lies, and manipulation, bringing terrifying secrets to light and triggering a bloody battle for survival.

1336053.title: Dendam Arwah Penari
1336053.overview: A terrifying horror from the past returns to haunt the present. When the spirit of a dancer comes seeking vengeance, no one knows who will be the next victim.

1353077.title: Your's Sincerely RAAM
1353077.trailerName: Your's Sincerely RAAM First Look Teaser | ⭐Ganesh | Ramesh Aravind | J.Anoop Seelin | A R.Vikhyath

1357813.title: My Heaven, Your Hell
1357813.overview: Over the years, Adela and Victoria live an impossible love story and are strongly punished by the law and by the society of the 60's and 70's in Spain. However, despite all the impediments, they cannot forget each other.

1358005.title: Office Romance
1358005.overview: Jackie, President and CEO of Air Cruz, runs a tight ship in her business, including a rigid anti-fraternization policy for all her employees. When a new sexy lawyer begins working for her, that policy becomes very tested.

1403189.title: Follies
1403189.overview: After 16 years together, François and Julie open their relationship to explore sexual adventures and self-discovery. With two kids and their bond at stake, the path proves more complex than expected.

1423093.title: Tafers Code
1423093.overview: Tafers Code follows five teenagers at the T.A.F. language school in Itaquaquecetuba, guided by the charismatic Teacher Gilmar. Each episode explores the unique challenges and strengths of the students as they discover how learning English can transform their lives. With humor, emotion, and a touch of documentary style, the series culminates in a final project that inspires not only the characters but everyone to take the first step toward a brighter future through language learning.

1426805.title: Emil and the Detectives
1426805.overview: Emil is spending his summer vacation with his grandmother in Berlin. But on the train there, he is robbed by the ruthless con artist Max Grundeis and a wild adventure begins! Together with his friends Pony, Gustav, Dienstag, Anh, and Jason, Emil sets off in pursuit and embarks on a fast-paced detective hunt across Berlin.

1445813.title: Trigger
1445813.overview: A disillusioned ex-soldier, Wyatt Kane, retreats into the woods, only to class with a team of State Police protecting a corrupt logging company. As tensions rise, Kane uncovers a conspiracy that forces him to fight for justice- no matter the cost.

1453301.title: The Gorals
1453301.overview: With 200 days left before college entrance exams, In-hye, who cares for the school's animal pen, spends her time lecturing a duck instead of studying. Seo-hee, punished for carrying a knife, joins her, and they discover an abandoned meadow where they lose the duck, Hee-seon. Meanwhile, teacher Kim Ah-tae forms a college interview prep group for four neglected students. On interview day, In-hye and Seo-hee ditch school to find Hee-seon, camping in the meadow and gradually learning to survive in the wild.

1454837.title: The Birthday Trip
1454837.overview: An unflinchingly funny satire following three millennial couples whose relationships are thrown into disarray when they descend on a luxury Southern Highlands farmstay for a birthday weekend they'll never forget.

1465717.title: Underland
1465717.overview: A cinematic voyage beneath the surface of the earth.

1476405.title: Synthetic
1476405.overview: The film is based on real-life events. Alena, a voice-over star, suddenly discovers that her voice has been stolen by the developers a major bank's neural network. Now her voice can be heard everywhere—from airport announcements to entertainment and gaming platforms. Alena realizes that in the modern reality a person's voice does not fall under legal protection. Thus, not only voice-over actors but everyone is at risk. The actress starts a struggle for the right to her own voice.

1478901.title: Red Razor On Soft Skin
1478901.overview: A giallo horror film about Benny Lazar, a timid son forced by his mother Moira to get a shave and a haircut from a mysterious barber. What ensues is a Technicolor nightmare of love, hate, betrayal, and self-destruction.
1478901.trailerName: RED RAZOR ON SOFT SKIN • OFFICIAL TRAILER • GIALLO HORROR SHORT FILM

1482549.title: Queen of Malacca
1482549.overview: At The Malacca Strait, a crucial shipping lane between the Malay Peninsula and Sumatra, the rise, rivalries, and power struggles of three formidable women—Rafah, Kartika and Layla—shape their criminal realm.

1484085.title: Atonement
1484085.overview: Based on Dexter Filkins’ resonant New Yorker article of the same name, about Marine Lu Lobello, haunted by memories of a deadly incident in Baghdad, whose journey of guilt and remorse leads him to reach out to Nora, the sole surviving member of the family he believes he may have harmed.

1487861.title: Elize: Shadows of a Woman
1487861.overview: In this retelling of a real case, a former escort discovers her wealthy husband's infidelity and struggles to cope as betrayal poisons their marriage.

1492341.title: Noah Kahan: Out of Body
1492341.overview: After rocketing to global fame, singer-songwriter Noah Kahan faces the pressure of making his next album and returns to his Vermont roots and family to get back in tune with himself.

1510325.title: Sweetheart
1510325.overview: A reluctant summer together transforms into an enchanting adventure when a young boy discovers his aunt's mysterious Sicilian house holds secrets and, perhaps, ancient spirits lurking within its walls.

1510517.title: Atlas King
1510517.overview: Ex-fighter returns from exile to bury his best friend and confront old rivalries. Reuniting with his godson, a streetwise enforcer entangled with a powerful crime syndicate, the two hatch a high-stakes heist in a desperate bid to escape the grip of a ruthless mob bos

1512629.title: Biermann
1512629.overview: Portrait of the German-German singer-songwriter and intellectual Wolf Biermann, whose famous Cologne concert in 1976 made German history.

1527285.title: Rodnee
1527285.overview: Rodnee is a broken schizophrenic consumed by drug-fueled binges and uncontrollable masturbation. His mind is over-crowded by disturbing hallucinations that manifest his traumas and most painful regrets as undefinable and monstrous pseudo-realities that constantly push him further off the edge of sanity.

1528501.title: Black Burns Fast
1528501.overview: Black Burns Fast is a queer and quirky coming of age film set in at a prestigious boarding school in South Africa. 17-year-old adorkable Luthando is on track for a normal academic year, until Ayanda arrives at the school and forces her to rethink everything. In the aftermath, Luthando struggles with juggling multiple identities to avoid rejection from her mother and her schoolmates as she comes to terms with her sexuality.

1529269.title: Odyssey
1529269.overview: Using rare footage, Odyssey chronicles Apollo 13's 1970 crisis through Jim Lovell's family perspective and global cooperation efforts. After tank explosion damaged vital systems, NASA worked to bring astronauts safely home.

1535349.title: Time of Cinema
1535349.overview: The story of those who see and make films, and the cinema that brings them together.

1536053.title: Sacred Heart: His Reign Has No End
1536053.overview: In the 17th-century, St. Margaret Mary has been hand-picked by Jesus to be His special disciple of His Sacred Heart. Through a series of apparitions at Paray-le-Monial, Jesus reveals His Heart to her. Through the centuries, countless others have been drawn to encounter the transformative power and beauty of the Sacred Heart.
1536053.trailerName: "Sacred Heart: His Reign Has No End" OFFICIAL U.S. TRAILER
1536053.original_title: Sacré Cœur: Son Règne N'a Pas De Fin

1542261.title: Doraemon the Movie: New Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil
1542261.overview: Nobita and friends finds a secret underwater castle packed with mysteries and riches. With Doraemon's high-tech gadgets, they dive into an ocean adventure mixing humor, teamwork, and imagination in a breathtaking aquatic world.
1542261.original_title: 映画ドラえもん 新・のび太の海底鬼岩城

1543797.title: Samurai Vengeance
1543797.overview: In January 1810 in Edo, Kikunosuke, the 17-year-old-son of a murdered samurai, takes revenge on his father's murderer, Sakubai, who was his father's former retainer. Kikunosuke gloriously defeats the swaggering Sakubai in single combat in front of a theater, witnessed by a huge audience that had just finished watching a production of 47 Ronin. With Sakubai's severed head, Kikunosuke has achieved his revenge and ensured that his family won't be exiled. 18 months later, a ronin named Soichiro Kase from Kikunosuke's domain arrives at the theater. While he seems silly and smooth-talking, he's very keen on finding out more about the incident and Kikunosuke's time working at the theater. The theater's staff – the barker Ippachi, the swordsmanship teacher Sagara, the costumer Hotaru, the craftsman Kyuzo, and the playwright Kinji – are apprehensive and suspicious at his digging. However, not everything is as it seems.

1544437.title: The Girl with the Leica
1544437.overview: The love story of Gerda Taro and Robert Capa.

1560309.title: All the Lovers in the Night
1560309.overview: Freelance proofreader Fuyuko's carefully ordered life in solitude begins to transform after meeting Mitsutsuka, a quiet high school physics teacher.
1560309.original_title: すべて真夜中の恋人たち

1561333.title: A.ni.mál
1561333.overview: In a provincial Philippine town, the naïve daughter of the mayor comes home with a video of a powerful family friend abusing his dog.

1565173.title: Sleeppers
1565173.overview: One day in the life of Angelos and Ioanna, each dealing with last night's fight.

1567605.title: Ebenezer
1567605.overview: Tale of an elderly miser who embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

1569461.title: Take Me Home
1569461.overview: Anna (Anna Sargent making her acting debut), a middle-aged Korean adoptee with a cognitive disability, cares for her aging parents in a fragile balance of meeting one another’s needs. Alongside her sister Emily (Ali Ahn) and her father (Victor Slezak), they must confront challenging questions about the future, but Anna remains determined to build a life where all of them can thrive.

1580533.title: #Untitled Sangeeth Shobhan - Palnati Surya Pratap Project

1584437.title: The Curse of the Silver Chain
1584437.overview: A silver chain that appears for centuries made by warlocks in the 15th century.
1584437.trailerName: The Curse of the Silver Chain - Trinity Rising  (Promo Trailer)
1584437.original_title: The Curse of the Silver Chain

1584885.title: Waves Turn
1584885.overview: Women reflect on their first year of motherhood and the many joys and challenges it brings – for parent and baby. A gentle, curious and informative conversational documentary about postpartum life, of sublime analogue beauty.

1592821.title: Mango Pachcha
1592821.overview: Set in Mysuru, a crime drama unfolds across a decade (2001-2011), following a chain of events that builds tension over time. The city's setting plays a key role in reflecting different phases across the years.

1593525.title: Boy
1593525.overview: While housesitting alone, Danny invites an older stranger over for a casual hookup. The charged encounter pushes Danny out of his comfort zone and into a world of confusion, forcing him to face the mismatch of who he is and who he appears to be.

1606965.title: Šeima į gamtą
1606965.overview: A modern family embark on a romantic nature trip in an attempt to reconnect. But the peace turns to chaos when their teenage children pose challenges, and the idyllic getaway becomes a comical struggle for survival.

1610933.title: Pha Chan
1610933.overview: A young couple become entangled in the ritual of "Pha Chan," a practice that severs ties either between living people or between the living and the dead.
1610933.trailerName: PHA JAAN Teaser with English Subtitle

1615605.title: Be My Valentine
1615605.overview: Gina has fallen in love with a man she hasn't met. As she documents her relationship journey, she becomes more and more obsessed with Zach to the point of bloody consequences.
1615605.trailerName: Be My Valentine  | Official Trailer | Stream for FREE on FOUND

1616181.title: Around Paradise
1616181.overview: In Caazapá, the “city of magic and legends”, two Paraguayan students are searching for happiness, gold and a magic bird. Their European dropout neighbours are hoping for freedom, healing and salvation from Armageddon. Everything has its price.

1621237.title: EPISODE 12
1621237.overview: On June 6th 2023 television show Paranormal Closure was pulled from all broadcast stations. With no statement as to why. Over a year later a video surfaced online claiming to be from the episode that never aired.

1624565.title: The Phone Booth
1624565.overview: A man is anxiously waiting for a pay phone to ring, while a dark presence is observing close-by.

1625205.title: Jackpot
1625205.overview: When Monika and Alfred call their three children to an urgent family meeting, the concerned siblings promptly arrive. But then comes the surprise: their parents have won the lottery! The problem? They don't intend to share a single cent with them. Three adult children, a fortune, and a lot of old scores to settle.

1626101.title: "Un tueur si proche": Ann Rule et Ted Bundy

1628661.title: Mongoose
1628661.overview: Captain Oleg Mangul travels to a remote town to investigate the mysterious disappearance of students, but soon realizes something is deeply wrong. Strange witnesses, eerie visions, and tracks leading into the mountains confront him with a mystery that defies human logic. Trying to escape this trap, Mangul finds himself drawn into a dangerous conflict where reality and deception intertwine, and his own past begins to play a decisive role.

1629109.title: Unholy Night
1629109.overview: The film centers on Gino, whose traditional Italian family Christmas Eve celebration descends into chaos when his deceased grandmother returns from the dead and embarks on a killing spree.  As more dead relatives begin appearing throughout the neighborhood, Gino must find a way to eliminate the holiday revenants and make it through the family gathering alive.

1632181.title: Accidental Partners
1632181.overview: Two women discover they were both scammed by the same man (who also got them pregnant). They form an alliance to take revenge.

1632245.title: Have you ever thanked God?
1632245.overview: Have You Ever Thanked God is a short reflective film that gently reminds us of the blessings we often overlook.  Through calm visuals and heartfelt narration, the film invites the viewer to pause, breathe, and notice the simple miracles hidden in everyday life.

1645237.title: A Little Park Music
1645237.overview: When a piano appears in the park gazebo, interfering with important work, city manager Allie joins forces with rookie cop Ryan to remove it, only to find both music and love are hard to resist.

1645621.title: WIND GAP
1645621.overview: Ming unexpectedly becomes pregnant in a dull relationship, and her life seems to have come to a sudden halt. She embarks on a journey to the China-Vietnam border alone, encountering gods and ghosts.

1646901.title: Proposal
1646901.overview: When a brother tries to stop his sister from proposing to her girlfriend, the siblings peel back the layers of their relationship in real time.

1654581.title: Nayyi Navelli
1654581.overview: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

1659445.title: The Hunger
1659445.overview: Victoria, a seamstress exhausted by hardship, sustains the fragile existence of her brother Lucas, who lives confined to a wheelchair in an environment of extreme poverty. However, prolonged deprivation awakens something dark: a monstrous transformation in Lucas that drives him to devour everything.

1664757.title: Impasto
1664757.overview: An illustrator in Paris is stuck in his routine and stuck for ideas, until he follows the music he hears from his window into the night...

1666165.title: For If Night Leaves Something Undone, the Day Undertakes to Complete It
1666165.overview: A found 16mm print of a short narrative film set in the American Civil War, along with Super 8 home movies of the filmmaker’s family in Iran during the Iran-Iraq War in the 1980s, are fused into a ghostly labyrinth. Made entirely on a JK Optical Printer, the film exhumes gestures, movements, conflicts, and forces in constant resurgence.

1667253.title: Vieyra, The Innovative Pioneer
1667253.overview: "Vieyra, The Innovative Pioneer" imagines a virtual encounter between pioneering Senegalese filmmaker Paulin Soumanou Vieyra and his grandsons during a visit to a museum retracing his life, highlighting his childhood, his encounters, his studies, and his work.

1667381.title: Queen of the Night vs. Night King 2
1667381.overview: Having broken away from the path laid out by her mother, Fuuka, now a former host turned yakuza, has teamed up with Ranmaru and reclaimed the title of "Queen," the number one hostess in the neon-lit district. However, her glory is threatened by the rise of a mysterious new hostess, Yuika. Ranmaru quickly gives up on Fuuka and tries to return to Yuika, but Yuika hides an ambition beneath her beautiful mask: to revive Jin, the "Night King," whose spirit has now been broken... (Sequel to "Queen Concerto 4")

1669045.title: Halina Ni Aliya
1669045.overview: Get an exclusive look at VMX star Aliya Raymundo’s irresistible charm and the roles that made her shine. Don’t miss these sizzling sneak peeks that will turn up the heat and make your summer even hotter.
1669045.trailerName: HALINA NI ALIYA Official Trailer | World Premiere this APRIL 14 only on VMX!

1671541.title: Three Kingdoms: The Beginning
1671541.overview: Toward the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty, amid nationwide unrest, Cao Cao and Yuan Shao sought to enlist General-in-Chief He Jin’s support to check the power of the eunuchs and restore the Han Dynasty to its rightful order. Unexpectedly, Dong Zhuo seized the chaos to march his troops into the capital, plotting to dethrone the reigning emperor and install a new one.Swept up in the torrential tide of troubled times, a host of warlords emerged one after another: Yuan Shu, Lü Bu, Sun Jian, as well as Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei. Turmoil engulfed Luoyang, and the fate of the great Han Empire stood at a crossroads…

1686133.title: The Apologist
1686133.overview: Through the ritual of saying sorry, a bold journey explores how apologies redefine history and what happens to us as witnesses to the act of atonement.

1686197.title: The Wolf
1686197.overview: Yuan, a 60 year old former village mayor in Shanghai, seeks freedom through heartbreak, marriage and LGBTQ+ repression in modern China.

1692277.title: The Daily Blues
1692277.overview: Many Men have it rough but struggling Guitarist Odie Freeman is the definition of the daily blues

1696309.title: Into the Darkness: The New Adventure
1696309.overview: Captain Jerico and the crew of his starship go on a mission to find his missing Uncle. On this adventure, they encounter some aliens with strange customs and learn some important lessons about tolerance.

1698869.title: Alien Disclosure Day
1698869.overview: A deep space mining ship returns to Earth carrying deadly alien stowaways. The aliens immediately launch a brutal attack on Earth. Now humanity must fight back, board the vessel, and destroy it before the planet is lost forever.

1699637.title: Siren
1699637.overview: One day, Seol-i’s father, Captain Park, captures a mermaid.

1700021.title: Rent in Peace
1700021.overview: When a desperate yet lousy landlord drags one of his tenants to evict another tenant from a long-abandoned house he had acquired as a property, the mission turns into a nightmare neither of them can escape.

1700789.title: Dream Stall
1700789.overview: When her father (Mark Lee) decides to shut down You & Me Bak Kut Teh, their family bak kut teh hawker business, top-scoring university graduate Enya (Annette Lee) takes it upon herself to save it.  She successfully persuades her childhood friends Tammy (Xixi Lim) and Ahji (Jaspers Lai) to quit their jobs and join her in reopening business, but their endeavour gets off to a bad start when famous local actress Estella Tsai (Ya Hui), with the help of her manager Doreen (Cassandra See), open a restaurant next to them, selling the exact same dish. 1763957.title: Deep Home Front
1763957.overview: Deep Home Front tells the story of the Kama region during the Great Patriotic War. Far from the front lines, people worked to the limits of their endurance, raised children, mourned loved ones, and believed that their labor was itself another front in the war. The film focuses on everyday life on the home front, where people sacrificed their health and, in some cases, were forced to live in circus arenas and orchestra pits. Teenage girls worked as blasters in the potash mines, laboratory assistants tested a typhus vaccine using methods unimaginable today, and more than 2000 housewives became record-breaking coal miners. These are only a few of the remarkable stories uncovered by the filmmakers. The screenplay is based on extensive research in state archives, departmental and municipal museums, and libraries. The production team also recorded dozens of interviews, while the film incorporates more than one hundred documented eyewitness accounts from the wartime years.
